name: HiDream-O1 Patch Seam Smoothing
plain: Runs the model extra times on circularly shifted inputs and blends the unshifted predictions to hide the 32-pixel patch grid. Costs one extra model call per extra shift, inside a percent window. Edge rows are feathered back to the unshifted prediction to hide wraparound.
math:
For each shift (sy,sx) in preset: p_i = roll(F(roll(x,(sy,sx))),(−sy,−sx)). Blend: mean, Hann window weights, or median.
Out = pred·(1−m·strength) + avg·(m·strength); m = edge ramp, 0 in P px strip then ramp over 4 px.
Ramp modes pick 2,4,8 passes by phase (t_start−t)/(t_start−t_end).

props.architectures: Node in model/patch/hidream. No type check in the wrapper; assumes 32-px patches.
